name: Shot-list prompt block (model-agnostic)
definition: One shot = prose scene + Cinematography (shot, mood) + 1-3 action beats + optional dialogue sized to the clip.
how: Fill: [style first]. [subject + setting + light + 3-5 palette colours]. Cinematography: Camera shot: <size, angle, lens>; Camera move: <one move>. Mood: <one feeling>. Actions: - <beat 1 concrete verbs> - <beat 2>. Dialogue: <short line or none>.
template:
<Style>. <Subject> in <setting>, <light>, palette <c1, c2, c3>.
Cinematography:
Camera shot: <size>, <angle>, <lens look>
Camera move: <one move, speed>
Mood: <one feeling>
Actions:
- <beat 1>
- <beat 2>
doc_support: Sora2Cookbook: template with Cinematography/Actions/Dialogue; style first; one camera move + one action; name 3-5 palette colours; concrete verbs
purpose: Forces every directing decision into the prompt so the model invents less.
use_when: any new shot on a model without a dedicated syntax
writing the prompt column of a shot list
avoid_when: I2V on Wan 5B where the image already carries the scene: shorten to motion-only (aivid.wan22.i2v_motion_only)

examples.note: template reproduced in structure, not wording

ai_video_prompt:
Flat 2D cartoon, thick outlines. A chibi boy with black rectangular glasses in a warm wooden room, palette oak brown, cream, navy.
Cinematography:
Camera shot: medium shot, eye level
Camera move: static
Mood: curious
Actions:
- he lowers his hand from his chin
- he looks toward screen right and smiles
common_mistakes: several camera moves in one block
check: Count moves (=1) and beats (<=3) before sending.

name: Positive constraints instead of negations
model: any; required on models without a negative field (Kling 2.6 API, Runway)
definition: Describe the wanted state ('smooth, stable camera', 'the glasses keep their exact shape') rather than 'no shake', 'no warping'.
how: Turn each 'no X' into the observable opposite. Where a negative field exists (Wan --negative, Veo negativePrompt per Google guide) list unwanted nouns there without 'no/don't'.
doc_support: RunwayGuide2026: 'Describe what you want to see, not what you want to avoid'; VeoPromptGuideCloud: avoid 'no'/'don't', list unwanted elements; CAPABILITY_MATRIX: FLUX negatives summon the object
purpose: Negations put the unwanted token into conditioning.

examples.note: 'Smooth, stable camera movement' instead of 'No camera shake'

ai_image_prompt: clean empty tabletop, plain seamless background
ai_video_prompt: Locked-off static camera. The eyeglasses stay rigid and keep their exact shape; only the sunlight moves slowly across the table.
common_mistakes: 'no people' on a model without negative field -> people appear

name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B — image-to-video, motion-only prompt (tools/wan.py)
model: Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B GGUF via ComfyUI (local, free)
definition: The input image sets the scene; the prompt states camera state + what moves + how fast.
how: python tools/wan.py <image> "<prompt>" out.mp4 --seconds 2 --steps 8 --seed N (draft) then --steps 20 (final); keep --size 480x848 on 6 GB; frames = 4n+1 at 24 fps; send a new --negative without 'people' when people are in shot.
template: <Camera state: locked-off static camera | slow push in>. <Rigid subject> stays still. <Secondary element> <moves> <slowly/gently>. <Light behaviour>.
doc_support: WanGitHub2025: TI2V-5B 24 fps, 1280x704 official, I2V may run with empty prompt (image carries scene), prompt extension optional; ComfyWan22: 5B fits ~8 GB with offload; tools/wan.py defaults (cfg 5, shift 8, uni_pc) from curriculum 10
purpose: Free ambient motion around a fixed subject.

examples.note: studio prompt for glasses by a window

ai_image_prompt: Vertical photo, eyeglasses on a pale oak table by a window, soft side light, calm cream palette, no text.
ai_video_prompt: Locked-off static camera. The glasses stay rigid and still on the table. Soft sunlight shifts slowly across the wood and a few dust motes drift through the light beam.
common_mistakes: using the default negative (contains 'people') for a person shot
check: Contact sheet at 2 fps; rigid subject unchanged in every frame.

name: Wan 2.2 — text-to-video b-roll (no product)
definition: Atmospheric shots with no locked asset.
how: Detailed prompt: subject, setting, light, camera framing (WanGitHub2025 examples cover subject, setting, lighting and camera framing). Note: tools/wan.py currently requires an image (I2V); T2V needs a workflow change or an image from FLUX first.
template: <Shot size> of <place> at <time>, <natural motion>, <light>, <camera move, speed>, <pace word>, natural colours.
doc_support: WanGitHub2025: example prompts are detailed (subject, setting, lighting, camera framing); TI2V does T2V and I2V
avoid_when: any shot that must match a real place or product
ai_video_prompt: Wide shot of a calm turquoise sea in early morning, small waves rolling onto pale sand, thin clouds drifting slowly, very slow pan from left to right, gentle meditative pace, natural colours.
check: Horizon level, no warped birds/people, no text.

name: Runway — [Camera Movement] + [Scene] + [Action] + [Details]
model: Runway Gen-4 (guide says also works for Veo 3.1)
definition: Lead with the camera/shot, then scene, one action, then style details.
how: One action per 5-10 s clip, one primary camera move; pick one speed + one movement quality; plain-language camera terms; generate 5-10 variations.
template: <Camera movement>. <Scene>. <One action>. <Details: light, texture, speed, quality>.
doc_support: RunwayGuide2026 formula, one action / one camera move, no 'then/next', speed+quality pairing, 5-10 variations
ai_video_prompt: Slow dolly forward. A quiet optical shop at dusk. The shopkeeper looks up from the counter and smiles. Warm tungsten light, gentle film grain, smooth gliding motion.
check: One verb of camera, one verb of subject.

name: Veo — element prompt with audio cues
model: Veo 3.1 / 3.1 Fast (Gemini API preview shut down 2026-10-22; GA on Enterprise platform — re-check)
definition: Subject, action, style, camera position/motion, composition, focus/lens, ambiance; audio in separate sentences, dialogue in quotes.
how: Durations 4/6/8 s; 9:16 supported; 24 fps; 1080p/4k need 8 s; native audio always on; English best.
doc_support: VeoGeminiDocs prompt elements + audio (dialogue in quotes, SFX, ambience), durations/fps/aspect; VeoPromptGuideCloud camera vocabulary and 'describe audio separately'
avoid_when: studio clips where music is added by the user

examples.note: 'Extreme close-up: a single raindrop landing on a red rose petal'

ai_video_prompt: Medium close-up, eye level. An elderly man puts on new glasses and reads a handwritten letter, his eyes widening slightly. Warm afternoon window light, soft film look. Audio: paper rustle, a soft exhale, distant birdsong.
common_mistakes: using a retired preview model id
check: Model id still listed in current docs; SynthID present (expected).

name: Veo 3.1 — up to 3 reference images for subject consistency
definition: Attach <=3 images of a person, character or product (type asset) so the subject keeps its appearance.
how: Duration must be 8 s; personGeneration allow_adult only for reference mode; prompt names the referenced subjects.
template: The <character> from the reference <action> with the <product> from the reference, <shot>, <light>.
doc_support: VeoGeminiDocs: referenceImages up to 3, asset type, 8 s required, not on Lite, allow_adult only
use_when: a series character or product must recur
ai_image_prompt: Character sheet on plain background, front/side/back, same outfit
ai_video_prompt: The boy from the reference picks up the eyeglasses from the reference and puts them on, medium close-up, eye level, warm afternoon light.

name: Veo 3.1 — extension chain
definition: Extend a Veo-generated clip by 7 s, up to 20 times (input <=141 s, 720p).
how: Prompt only what happens next; keep a voice line inside the final second if speech should continue.
template: Continue: <next action>, same camera and light.
doc_support: VeoGeminiDocs: +7 s x20, Veo-only inputs, 720p, voice may not extend if no speech in last second
ai_video_prompt: Continue: she walks to the window and looks out, same handheld-steady camera, same warm light.

name: Kling 2.6 — first + last frame (product turn between two real photos)
definition: first_frame + last_frame force the start and end views; prompt describes the path between.
how: Resolution must be 1080p; audio must be off with last_frame; duration 5 or 10 s; prompt <=2,500 chars; no separate negative field (put constraints in text, positively); images >=300 px, aspect 1:2.5-2.5:1.
template: The camera orbits <direction> <degrees> around the <rigid product> at a constant slow speed; the <product> keeps its exact shape; same light and background throughout.
doc_support: KlingAPI26 parameters and constraints; curriculum 10 (same light/background or the model morphs)
purpose: Real product at both ends of a move.
use_when: two kit photos with identical light/background, <=45 deg apart
ai_video_prompt: The camera orbits 45 degrees to the right around the eyeglasses at a constant slow speed; the frame and temples keep their exact shape; same soft studio light and seamless grey background throughout.
check: Every frame vs the real photo: shape, colour, logo.

name: Kling Motion Brush + Static Brush
model: Kling (web UI; version not named on the page)
definition: Brush up to 6 elements with trajectories; Static Brush pins areas (e.g. the glasses, or a strip along the bottom to stop camera drift).
how: Prompt as 'element + motion' matching the brushed area; one connected region of one category per brush; impossible trajectories become camera paths.
purpose: Move hair/fabric while the product stays still.
use_when: model wearing glasses, breeze in hair
avoid_when: API-only workflows where masks are not available in the version used

examples.note: 'a puppy running on the road' element+motion form

ai_video_prompt: Her hair lifts gently in a sea breeze.
common_mistakes: brushing two categories in one brush
check: Static-brushed area identical to frame 1 at the end.

name: Hailuo — bracket camera commands
definition: 15 commands: [Truck left] [Truck right] [Pan left] [Pan right] [Push in] [Pull out] [Pedestal up] [Pedestal down] [Tilt up] [Tilt down] [Zoom in] [Zoom out] [Shake] [Tracking shot] [Static shot].
how: Same bracket = simultaneous (max 3, comma-separated); separate brackets in order = sequential. Set prompt_optimizer=false for precise control. 6 s or 10 s at 768P; 1080P only 6 s.
doc_support: MiniMaxI2V: command list, combination rules, 'explicit commands are more accurate', prompt_optimizer, durations
purpose: Most explicit documented camera control among the models read.
ai_video_prompt: [Push in] The woman slowly lifts her gaze to the camera and smiles softly, hair moving in a light breeze.
common_mistakes: leaving prompt_optimizer on and getting rewritten prompts
check: Camera move in output matches the bracket.

name: Hailuo — first & last frame endpoint
definition: Separate endpoint with last_frame_image; resolution follows the first frame; mismatched last frame is cropped; no 512P.
how: Prepare both frames at the same size and aspect.
template: <path of motion between the frames>, <rigid object keeps shape>, <light constant>.
doc_support: MiniMaxI2V search results for the FL2V reference (first/last frame rules)
ai_video_prompt: The boy walks from the doorway to the desk, facing screen right, camera tracking alongside at eye level, room and light unchanged.

name: Luma Ray 2 — keyframes frame0/frame1 and generation chaining
model: ray-2 / ray-flash-2 (page points to newer Agents API)
definition: frame0/frame1 accept an image URL or a previous generation id: extend, reverse-extend, or interpolate between generations; loop flag.
how: Camera move as phrase from /camera_motion/list inside the prompt (e.g. 'camera orbit left'); concepts e.g. dolly_zoom.
avoid_when: endpoint deprecated in your account — check first

examples.note: 'A tiger walking in snow' with a start frame

ai_video_prompt: camera orbit left, the eyeglasses rest on black velvet while a soft highlight slides along the rim.
common_mistakes: passing local images (needs own CDN URL)

name: 2.5D depth parallax push (no generation)
definition: Depth map splits layers; HTML camera pushes/parallaxes; product pixels never regenerated.
how: python tools/depth.py <image> depth.png; animate in HyperFrames; push/orbit <= ~8% before edges tear (curriculum 10 §4.3).
template: (no text prompt) push in 5-8% over 3-4 s, ease-in-out
ai_image_prompt: clean layered scene with clear foreground, midground, background separation

name: Last-frame handoff chain (any I2V, incl. wan.py)
definition: Extract the last frame of shot A and use it as the first frame of shot B.
how: ffmpeg -sseof -0.05 -i A.mp4 -frames:v 1 -update 1 A_last.png ; python tools/wan.py A_last.png "<next motion>" B.mp4 --seed <same>. Limit to ~3 links, then re-anchor from a keyframe made with the reference sheet.
template: Continue the same motion: <next action>, same camera, same light.
doc_support: CRAFT (no official doc for wan.py chaining); Luma/Veo document their own chaining (LumaDocsRay2, VeoGeminiDocs)
purpose: Continuous action on a model without extend.
ai_video_prompt: Continue the same slow pan to the right across the shop shelves, same warm light.
common_mistakes: using a blurred last frame (motion blur propagates)
check: Compare colour/identity at each seam on the cut sheet.

name: Iterate one controlled change at a time
definition: When a result is close, keep everything and change one variable ('same shot, switch to 85 mm'); if a shot keeps failing, simplify (freeze camera, reduce action, clear background) then add back.
how: Lock seed where available; log prompt diffs in LEARNING-LOG.
purpose: Learn cause and effect; avoid random walks.
ai_video_prompt: Same shot, same action, but the camera is now locked off.
common_mistakes: changing 3 things and not knowing which helped
